messages.subject: Summer meeting times: Thurs 1-3
parts:
Hi all,

The people have spoken and we will have our summer work sessions Thursdays, 1-3PM in Wickson 2124, starting this week.

Over the summer, we won't have speakers, just work sessions, Q&A, and presentations for feedback (and cookies!).  If you want to present some of your own work/code/plots for feedback, let me know.
